topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The package arrived without a note, wrapped in familiar paper, the pattern a tableau of faded schoolyard memories. I trace the edges, fingers hesitant over the worn tape. Opening it, the scent of aged books and chalk dust spills out—a time capsule from a past I keep at arm's length. Inside, a small, leather-bound diary, its pages yellowing, a ribbon loose. I recognize my own handwriting, notes and dreams of a young student long ago. The weight of it all is heavy, too heavy, and the room feels smaller, the air thick. I close the cover, tucking it away, promising to myself never to open it again.
